description: Integrate reels admin page into existing admin navigation and verify end-to-end functionality
steps: Verify that the Reels nav item already exists in frontend/app/admin/admin-shell.tsx SECTIONS config (it's already there in the Content section)
Test that clicking the Reels nav item properly navigates to /admin/reels and activates the correct nav state
Add proper page metadata to the reels page following the pattern from other admin pages
Verify the admin layout properly wraps the reels page and applies consistent styling
Test responsive behavior of the reels admin page on mobile and desktop viewports
Verify authentication flow - unauthenticated users should be redirected to /admin/login
Test role-based access - only users with catalog_manager/admin/super_admin roles should access reels admin
acceptance_criteria: Reels nav item is properly highlighted when on /admin/reels page
Page title in browser tab shows 'Reels · Admin Console' following the metadata template pattern
Reels admin page is properly protected by authentication middleware
Users without proper roles receive 403 Forbidden when accessing reels API endpoints
Page layout and styling is consistent with other admin pages across all screen sizes
verification: Manual test: navigate through admin sidebar and verify Reels link works correctly
Manual test: sign out and verify /admin/reels redirects to login page
Manual test: sign in with different role levels and verify access control
Visual test: compare reels page styling with products page for consistency
